$comment: Generated from policy.yaml by `uv run dd-gen-schema <path to policy.yaml>`. Do not edit.

GroundingRef.description: The identity and content hash of one retrieved thing a payload rests on. The only way a payload may name an external resource as a decided identity, and the only place it names it: what the reference identifies is read from the evidence item with the same source_id and content_hash (ADR-0015). The linter matches every GroundingRef against a retrieval span on both fields.
GroundingRef.title: GroundingRef

MatchedPolicy.description: One policy record matched to an actor. It is named only in grounded_on; the record's name, clauses and relations are in the cited evidence item's content (ADR-0015).

actor.description: The name of the actor, as given in the input, that this policy was matched to.

notes.description: Facts to weigh beside the obligations, such as a policy subject outside the discipline or a policy dated after the publication.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

MatchedPolicy.title: MatchedPolicy

Obligation.description: What a policy record says about one kind of obligation, read from a curated field by a fixed rule.

recorded_as.description: The value FAIRsharing's curators recorded, such as "suggested" or "no", kept so that an unstated strength does not hide what the record says.

Obligation.title: Obligation

PolicyConflict.description: Matched policies that state one kind of obligation differently. Grounded on every policy involved, and flagged for human review.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).

PolicyConflict.title: PolicyConflict

RepositoryRef.description: A repository a policy requires, in the form advisor.repository takes as RepositoryNeeds.mandated.
RepositoryRef.title: RepositoryRef

SearchedSummary.description: What was looked for, so a reader can judge an abstention as well as a match.

snapshot_ref.description: Which copy of the registry answered, e.g. fairsharing-policy:snapshot:2026-10-29.

SearchedSummary.title: SearchedSummary

description: The policy advisor payload. The policies matched to each actor, what each asks, where they differ, and the actors with no policy record. Conflicts are flagged for human review; the agent does not resolve them.

schema_class.description: Type designator: the name of the class this object is an instance of. Discriminates the input and payload unions, and lets a consumer name a payload class it does not recognise.

mandated_repositories.description: Repositories a matched policy requires, as FAIRsharing relates them. Empty when no policy record names one, which is not evidence that none is mandated.

no_record.description: Actors for which no FAIRsharing policy record was found.

grounded_on.description: The retrieved things this object rests on. For grounding mode retrieval, each entry names a retrieval span; for input_only and none, the single entry is the input itself (source_id input:<invocation_id>, content_hash the dd-input-json-v1 hash).
